question: Transformer oil should have _______ dielectric strength and _______ viscosity.
solution:
The correct answer is __high; low__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Transformer oil__ is used in electrical transformers for insulation and cooling purposes.
 
• It should have high dielectric strength to prevent electrical breakdown.
 
• Low viscosity ensures better heat dissipation and circulation within the transformer.
 
• The oil also protects transformer windings from moisture and oxidation.
 
• Regular testing of transformer oil is essential to maintain its insulating properties and performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Dielectric Strength:**
 
 
• It measures the ability of a material to withstand high voltage without breaking down.
 
• Transformer oil with high dielectric strength ensures safe insulation between components.
 
 
 
• **Viscosity:**
 
 
• Viscosity refers to the thickness or resistance of a fluid to flow.
 
• Low viscosity oil circulates easily, aiding in efficient cooling of the transformer.
 
 
 
• **Maintenance Tips:**
 
 
• Routine oil testing helps in early detection of contamination or degradation.
 
• Proper filtration and purification of oil extend its usability and enhance transformer life.
